'''Oleg Oleksandrovych Krishtal''' (born in 1945, [[Kyiv]]) is a scientist in the field of [[biophysics]], a full member of the [[National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine]] (1997),<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS">{{Cite web|title=Krishtal O. at the portal of the National Academy of Sciences of Ukraine|url=https://www.nas.gov.ua/EN/PersonalSite/Pages/default.aspx?PersonID=0000006831|access-date=2023-11-08|website=www.nas.gov.ua|language=en-UK}}</ref> a member of [[Academia Europaea]] (1990),<ref name="KrishtalOK@AE">{{Cite web|title=Krishtal O. at the portal of Academia Europaea|url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Krishtal_Oleg|access-date=2023-11-08|website=www.ae-info.org|language=en-UK}}</ref> Doctor of Biological Sciences (1981), and professor (1983).<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" /> He is a laureate of the State Prize of the USSR and Ukraine in science and technology<ref name="KrishtalOK@AE"/> and one of the most cited Ukrainian scientists.<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Ioannidis  | first1 = J. P. A.  | last2 = Baas  | first2 = J. | last3 = Klavans
 | first3 = R.  | last4 = Boyack
 | first4 = K. W.  | title = A standardized citation metrics author database annotated for scientific field  | journal = PLOS Biology  | volume = 17
 | issue = 8  | article-number = e3000384  | date = 2019
 | doi = 10.1371/journal.pbio.3000384  | pmid =  31404057 | pmc = 6699798 | doi-access = free  }}</ref>

== Biography ==

Oleg Krishtal was born on July 5, 1945, in Kyiv,<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" /> into the family of biologist-scientist {{ill|Oleksandr Pylypovych Krishtal|uk|Кришталь Олександр Пилипович}}, a professor and head of the Department of Invertebrate Physiology at [[Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv]].

In 1968, he graduated from the Faculty of Physics at Taras Shevchenko National University of Kyiv, majoring in "Molecular Physics".<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" />

Since 1970, he has been working at [[Bogomoletz Institute of Physiology]], starting as a junior research fellow and later becoming a senior research fellow. Since 1982, he has been heading the Department of Cellular Membranology.<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" /> From 2003 to 2010, he served as the deputy director of the O.O. Bogomoletz Institute of Physiology, NAS of Ukraine. From 2010 to 2021, he was the director of the institute.<ref name="deptcm">{{Cite web|title=Department of Cellular Membranology of Bogomoletz Institute of Physiology|url=http://deptcm.kiev.ua/index.php?id=krishtal|access-date=2023-11-08|website=deptcm.kiev.ua|language=en-UK}}</ref><ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" /> Also, from 2010 to 2016, he headed the International Center for Molecular Physiology.

At different times, he has worked as a visiting professor at Kyushu University (Japan), Harvard University (USA), Complutense University of Madrid (Spain), and the University of Pennsylvania (USA).<ref name="deptcm" />

== Scientific activity ==

Krishtal is a co-author of the development of the method of intracellular dialysis of nerve cells,<ref>{{Cite journal | last1 = Kostyuk  | first1 = PG  | last2 = Krishtal  | first2 = OA  | last3 = Pidoplichko
 | first3 = VI  | title = Effect of internal fluoride and phosphate on membrane currents during intracellular dialysis of nerve cells  | journal = Nature  | volume = 257
 | issue = 5528  | pages = 691–693  | date = 1975-10-23
 | doi = 10.1038/257691a0  | pmid = 1186845 | bibcode = 1975Natur.257..691K | s2cid = 1354301 }}</ref> which made it possible to study their electrophysiological properties. He also discovered two fundamentally new receptors in nerve cells: [[Acid-sensing ion channel|acid-sensing ion channels]]<ref>{{Cite journal  | last1 = Krishtal  | first1 = OA  | last2 = Pidoplichko  | first2 = VI  | title = A receptor for protons in the nerve cell membrane  | journal = Neuroscience  | volume = 5  | issue = 12  | pages = 2325–2327  | date = 1980  | doi = 10.1016/0306-4522(80)90149-9  | pmid = 6970348 | s2cid = 45351726 }}</ref> and [[P2X purinoreceptor|ionotropic receptors for ATP]].<ref>{{Cite journal  | last1 = Krishtal  | first1 = OA
 | last2 = Marchenko  | first2 = SM  | last3 = Pidoplichko
 | first3 = VI  | title = Receptor for ATP in the membrane of mammalian sensory neurones  | journal = Neuroscience Letters  | volume = 35  | issue = 1  | pages = 41–45
 | date = 1983-01-31  | doi = 10.1016/0304-3940(83)90524-4
 | pmid = 6302606 | s2cid = 30822628
 }}</ref>

He is a member of the editorial board of the journals "Fiziologichnyi Zhurnal" (Bogomoletz Institute of Physiology),<ref>{{Cite web|title=Editorial board of Fiziolohichnyi zhurnal|url=https://fz.kiev.ua/index.php?page=2|access-date=2023-11-08|website=fz.kiev.ua/|language=en-UK}}</ref> "Neurophysiology" (Bogomoletz Institute of Physiology and Springer-Nature),<ref>{{Cite web|title=Editorial board of Neurophysiology journal|url=https://www.springer.com/journal/11062/editors|access-date=2023-11-08|website=www.springer.com|language=en-UK}}</ref> and "Membranes: Membranes in Life Sciences" (MDPI).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Editorial board of Membranes journal|url=https://www.mdpi.com/journal/membranes/editors|access-date=2023-11-08|website=www.mdpi.com|language=en-UK}}</ref>

For many years, research of Oleg Krishtal has focused on the role of membrane proteins, mainly ion channels and metabotropic receptors, in the functioning of single neurons, neural networks, and whole organs. The current research topics of his department<ref name="deptcm" /> are:
* biophysical and pharmacological properties of ion channels and receptors of cellular membranes (plasmalemma and nuclear envelope);
* molecular mechanisms of epilepsy and epileptogenesis and pharmacological agents with antiseizure properties;
* the role of membrane receptors and ion channels in synaptic plasticity, learning, and integral activity of the nervous system and behavior;
* peripheral and central mechanisms of pain and possible ways of its correction;
* the use of stem cells for the treatment of neurological disorders (Alzheimer's, Parkinson's disease, epilepsy, and ischemic stroke), and traumatic injuries of the spinal cord.

Kryshtal is also the author of several books:<ref>{{Cite journal  | last1 = Krishtal  | first1 = OA

== Public activity ==

Krishtal serves as the president of the Ukrainian Scientific Club,<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ukrainian Scientific Club official site|url=https://www.nauka.in.ua|access-date=2023-11-08|website=www.nauka.in.ua|language=en-UK}}</ref> the Ukrainian Physiological Society named after P.G. Kostiuk,<ref>{{Cite web|title= Президія Центральної Ради Українського фізіологічного товариства ім. П.Г. Костюка|url=http://biph.kiev.ua/uk/Rada|access-date=2023-11-08|website=biph.kiev.ua|language=uk-UA}}</ref> and the Ukrainian Society for Neuroscience.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ukrainian Society for Neuroscience official site|url=http://usn.org.ua/?setlang=en|access-date=2023-11-08|website=usn.org.ua|language=en-UK}}</ref> He gives many popular science lectures and appears as a guest on radio and television programs.<ref name="KrishtalOA@NAS" />
